headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Appoints Crude Oil Export Inspection Agents
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria has appointed eight pre-shipment inspection agents and two monitoring and evaluation agents for crude oil exports.
why: Monitoring crude oil exports is critical for transparency and revenue tracking in Nigeria's oil-dependent economy.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Appointment of inspection agents regulates crude oil exports.
